The method of ∃+ -saturated co-retracts was recently generalized by Abramsky and Reggio [2], though the lens of game comonads and arboreal categories. They give general conditions leading to equi-resource homomorphism preservation theorems, both with respect to fragments of first-order logic and relativized to classes of structures satisfying certain axioms. Our proof of Theorem 1.4 does not follow this template, but it would be interesting to know if a ∃+ -saturation proof is possible in the finite setting.
